title: tls_wolfssl Module
content_markdown:
This module implements TLS operations using the [_wolfSSL_](https://www.wolfssl.com/) libarary. It provides the primitives required by the _tls\_mgm_ module in order to expose a higher-level API used by TLS-based protocol modules like _proto\_tls_ or _proto\_wss_.

The _wolfSSL_ library is statically-linked and bundled with this module so no installation or external dependency is required.

exported_parameters.name: try_use_ktls
exported_parameters.description: Try to use KTLS for RX and TX ( dependent on Kernel support and loaded modules https://docs.kernel.org/networking/tls-offload.htm ) If kernel support is not found, or if the cypher attempted to be used is not supported ( only AES-GCM for now ), then SSL operations will continue to be done in user-space. IF NIC supports SSL offloading, that can also be enabled without any changes needed to the module https://docs.nvidia.com/doca/sdk/ktls-offloads/index.html
